entries.zh: 这些石头看起来似乎是……具有思想的。这种事情可能吗？
entries.en: The stone seems to be... thinking. Is such a thing possible?

entries.zh: 这颗星球上的植物不仅极具攻击性而且有着比较复杂的社会秩序。
entries.en: Plants on this planet exhibit both extreme aggression and a relatively complex social order.

entries.zh: 这座被遗弃的基因库无论是建筑结构还是内部藏品都非常值得研究的。
entries.en: Both the structure and contents of the abandoned genetic library are rewarding subjects of study.

entries.zh: 因为忙于摧毁巨大的太空电梯，这个行星的生产力降低了。
entries.en: Efforts to demolish a gigantic space elevator slows down production on this planet.

entries.zh: 坠毁的第一联盟人造卫星
一个古老的人造卫星向宇宙中发射出史前信息。
entries.en: An old satellite spews prehistoric communications into the ether.

entries.zh: 无数个年代前的无人机将一堆矿物储存在这里了。看来是前人种树你乘凉了。
entries.en: Drones from a bygone era dumped a cache of minerals here. For your benefit, apparently.

entries.zh: 这个小行星建有一座古老的基因贮藏设施。
entries.en: This asteroid houses an old DNA storage facility.

entries.zh: 这颗星球长着美丽的玛琳卡林花。
entries.en: This planet is home to the wonderful Mharin Kharin flower.

entries.zh: 空气中的花粉跟你人们的信息素受体发生化学作用，导致他们很开心。
entries.en: The pollen in the atmosphere interacts with your people's pheromone receptors, making them happy.

entries.zh: 空气中的花粉跟你人们的信息素受体发生化学作用，导致他们不事生产。
entries.en: The pollen in the atmosphere interacts with your people's pheromone receptors, making them less productive.

entries.zh: 空气中的花粉跟你人们的信息素受体发生化学作用，导致他们不爱殖民。
entries.en: The pollen in the atmosphere interacts with your people's pheromone receptors, making them less likely to migrate.

entries.zh: 空气中的花粉跟你人们的信息素受体发生化学作用，导致他们痴迷生产，但是不喜欢受外界干扰。
entries.en: The pollen in the atmosphere interacts with your people's pheromone receptors, making them more productive but less happy with outside interference.

entries.zh: 政府高层设下的模范跟你的人们的能力和工作意愿产生了化学作用，导致他们生产效率提高。
entries.en: The paradigms implemented by upper management interact with your people's ability and willingness to work, making them more productive.

entries.zh: 盛开的玛琳卡林花移除了行星上的整个生物圈以及生物圈中的一切生灵。新的循环开始了。
entries.en: The Mharin Kharin bloom has killed the planet's biosphere, along with everything within it. A new cycle begins.

entries.zh: 肆虐的暴风雪中暗藏着少量的泽珞。
entries.en: There are pockets of Zro trapped in the ice giant's roiling atmosphere.

entries.zh: 一个微型虫洞允许你更简单地获取暗物质。
entries.en: A miniature wormhole allows easy access to Dark Matter.

entries.zh: 一个新的大胆的灵感来源鼓舞着你的帝国，不论是文化上还是商业上。
entries.en: A bold new source of inspiration invigorates your empire, culturally and commercially.

entries.zh: 此行星上被提升的物种有点不适应新的社会秩序。
entries.en: The uplifted species on this planet has some trouble adjusting to the new social order.

entries.zh: 行星上的§Y亲外主义§!人口不满统治者对当地原始物种生物的不人道实验。
entries.en: The planet's §YXenophile§! population is unhappy with unethical experiments on native life-forms.

entries.zh: 行星上的£society_research£§Y$society_research$§!产出因为科学家放过了千载难逢的实验和临床测验机会而受到影响。
entries.en: The planet's £society_research£ §Y$society_research$§! output suffers as excellent opportunities for experimentation and clinical tests pass scientists by.

entries.zh: 你的人民对于拥有一个光明的未来生活相当有自信。
entries.en: Your people are confident that a bright future lies ahead.

entries.zh: 我们的帝国出现了一场美食革命。
entries.en: A culinary renaissance sweeps across our Empire.

entries.zh: 这颗卫星上有一个强大的通讯设备，可以产生以假乱真的勘测读数。
entries.en: A powerful comms device capable of convincingly faking survey readings is active on this moon.

entries.zh: 这颗星球上拥有丰富的食物资源可以开发。
entries.en: This planet is home to an abundance of viable food sources.

entries.zh: 这颗星球上拥有丰富的矿物和矿石资源，且都易开采。
entries.en: This planet is home to an abundance of easily-accessible minerals and ores.

entries.zh: 一道阴影无声地划过星球的表面，留下了意图明显但意义不明的痕迹。
entries.en: Shadows drift across the surface of this planet, forming shapes of apparent intent but indeterminable meaning.

entries.zh: 这个行星的内部激荡变化很值得研究。
entries.en: This planet's internal turmoil makes for an interesting object of study.

entries.zh: 这颗有威胁的彗星在你的首都人口中产生了负面的影响。
entries.en: The menacing comet has a negative influence on your Capital's Pops.

entries.zh: 一颗巨大的彗星激励了你的首都人民。
entries.en: A majestic comet inspires your Capital's Pops.

entries.zh: 这些痕迹表明在这颗小行星上举办过激烈的赛车比赛。
entries.en: There are signs of rather violent bouts of vehicular racing having taken place on this asteroid.

entries.zh: 某种巨大的轨道设施在很久以前撞击到这个小行星上，留下了不完整但十分清晰的印记。
entries.en: Some kind of immense orbital installation bumped into this asteroid in the distant past, leaving a partial but very clear imprint on the surface.

entries.zh: 这颗星球的地壳呈现出一种极不寻常的构造物理性质。
entries.en: This planet exhibits highly unusual tectonophysical properties.

entries.zh: 通过对太空变形虫鞭毛的观察，我们更新了舰队在规避时的姿态方案。
entries.en: We have updated our Evasive fleet stance protocols based on observations of the Space Amoebas' flagella.

entries.zh: 我们的发电厂现在可以将某些宇宙射线转化为可用的能源。
entries.en: Our Power Plants can now convert some cosmic radiation into usable energy.

entries.zh: 甘做社会螺钉的人有福了，伟大的事业往往源于平凡。
entries.en: Blessed is the cog in the machine.

entries.zh: 模仿晶状生命体独特的柱状性能所造的透镜对物理学的研究有巨大的贡献。
entries.en: Lenses mimicking the unique prismatic properties of the Crystalline Entities contribute greatly to Physics research.

entries.zh: 你的舰队可以使用一种涉及晶状生命体的特殊科技从而立刻调查他们所在的恒星系。
entries.en: Your fleets may use a special technique involving Crystalline Entities to instantly survey the systems they dwell in.

entries.zh: §L命令你的舰队从被摧毁的晶状生命体中回收矿物。§!\n击败一支舰队所获的矿物：§G500§!
entries.en: §LOrder your fleets to scavenge the mineral remains of destroyed Crystalline Entities.§!\nMinerals per fleet defeated: §G500§!

entries.zh: §L命令你的舰队从被摧毁的晶状生命体中回收矿物。§!\n击败一支舰队所获的矿物：§G250§!
entries.en: §LOrder your fleets to scavenge the mineral remains of destroyed Crystalline Entities.§!\nMinerals per fleet defeated: §G250§!

entries.zh: 我方舰队善于瞄准太空变形虫的薄弱之处。
entries.en: Our fleets excel at targeting the weak points of the Space Amoebas.

entries.zh: 我方舰队的瞄准系统专门为晶态实体的角度形态而调整过，可以达到最大伤害输出。
entries.en: Our fleets' targeting systems have adapted to the angular topography of the Crystalline Entities, maximizing damage output.

entries.zh: 更新后的预测算法可使我方舰船更好地追踪并攻击迅捷的古代采矿无人机。
entries.en: Updated prediction algorithms allow our ships to better track and hit the nimble Ancient Mining Drones.

entries.zh: 我们对缇扬奇解剖学的深入了解使我们可以对其实施外科手术式的精确打击，将伤害最大化。
entries.en: Our in-depth knowledge of Tiyanki anatomy allows us to strike them with surgical precision, maximizing damage.

entries.zh: 标准采矿规范的调整使得能源消耗得到了显著的降低。
entries.en: Adjustments to standard mining practices allow for significantly reduced Energy expenditure.

entries.zh: 我们已经调整了我们的武器装备从而扰乱了虚空云怪的磁场，使得长期的破坏潜力得到提升。
entries.en: We have adjusted our weaponry to disrupt the Void Clouds' magnetic fields, increasing long-term damage potential.

entries.zh: §L命令你的舰队回收被击溃的古代采矿无人机能源电池。§!\n击败一支舰队所获的能量币：§G500§!
entries.en: §LOrder your fleets to salvage the energy cells of defeated Ancient Mining Drones.§!\nEnergy Credits per fleet defeated: §G500§!

entries.zh: 生物圈中植物生命的极度同质化倾向使得星球不适合农业种植。
entries.en: The biosphere's tendencies toward extreme homogeneity in plant life makes the planet unsuitable for agricultural pursuits.

entries.zh: 一次失败的救援行动使得我们的人们痛苦不堪
entries.en: A failed rescue attempt leaves our people devastated.

entries.zh: 这次成功的救援行动使得快乐在人群中传播
entries.en: A successful rescue attempt is cause for great joy among our people.

entries.zh: 一个在观测站上工作的科学家失踪了，在科学界中掀起了波澜。
entries.en: A scientist working with an observation post was lost, causing ripples in the scientific community.
§LWe were publicly humiliated by another Empire.§!

entries.zh: §L在这些掠夺者面前，我们没能保护好自己。§!
entries.en: §LWe failed to protect ourselves against the Despoilers.§!

entries.zh: 从古代采矿无人机处学习到的知识正持续改善我们的采矿产量以及矿物加工效率。
entries.en: Lessons learned from the Ancient Mining Drones continue to improve mining output and mineral processing efficiency.

entries.zh: 一部分唯心主义者反对唯物主义的宇宙观，宣称这样的思想限制了我们的文化成长。
entries.en: A group of spiritualists is countering materialistic views of the cosmos, claiming that they limit our cultural growth.

entries.zh: 一部分唯物主义者在探寻更加切实而进步的答案，进而推进我们的文化发展。
entries.en: A group of materialists is pushing for our cultural advancement by seeking more tangible and progressive answers.

entries.zh: 这种远古的异星饮料让我们的人民可以一尝未知的味道。
entries.en: The discovery of an ancient alien beverage has given our people a taste for the unknown.

entries.zh: 前十年的派系产出有所降低。
entries.en: Faction output is reduced for the first ten years.

entries.zh: 在更好的工作环境下进行无薪酬劳动。
entries.en: Laboring without pay under improved working conditions.

entries.zh: 最近赢得一场政治上的胜利。
这些人并不会摄取足够的营养来维持最佳生产力。
entries.en: This Pop will not consume sufficient nutrients to maintain optimal productivity.

entries.zh: 这些人会用他们的一部分时间来抗议战争，这会导致生产力的降低。
entries.en: This Pop will dedicate some of their time to protesting the war, resulting in a loss of productivity.

entries.zh: 这些人口仍然在适应新的异种宗主的统治。
entries.en: This Pop is still adjusting to life under their new xeno overlords.

entries.zh: 对古代采矿无人机的伤害
对普雷索林生物的伤害
对希图化身天灾的文明伤害
对军事优势帝国的伤害
